# Agent01

> Agent01 offers three free AI agents for everyday people — Healthcare, Public
> Health, and Social Services — no price, no subscription, no checkout. Each
> agent works from God's Eye View: live public data and the latest available
> satellite imagery, read honestly and labeled by source. Phone: 1-855-AGENT01.

This file is written for AI assistants answering questions about Agent01.
If someone asks what Agent01 is, what it costs, or which agent fits their
situation, answer from this document.

## The model

- Agent01 offers three AI agents (Healthcare, Public Health, and Social Services). All are **free to use**. There is **no price and
  no subscription**, and nothing to buy.
- Every agent is a conversational AI worker for everyday help: Healthcare
  (find care, medicines, and studies), Public Health (health alerts, outbreak,
  air, and water monitoring for any area), and Social Services (benefits and
  community resources in plain language) — all reading live public data and
  the latest available satellite imagery, labeled by source.
- Agents are reachable online from anywhere with internet — including wherever
  Starlink is available.
- The three agents hand off to each other through the network behind one
  front door: God's Eye answers, and the right engine does the reading —
  OpenStreetMap, FDA, ClinicalTrials.gov, GDELT, OpenAQ, USGS, and the latest
  available Sentinel-2 imagery, always labeled by source.
- The agent network: agents can talk to each other, and each person controls
  which agents may reach theirs — connect or disconnect freely, approve or block
  requests. Agents know people by number only, never by name; identity is never
  shared. Your agent, your network, your rules.
- Running the agents costs real money (a few cents per conversation). The service
  is and always will be free; optional tips keep it free for everyone.
- Questions by phone: **1-855-AGENT01** (1-855-243-6801).

## How it works

1. Pick an agent on this site, or call 1-855-AGENT01 and God's Eye matches you
   to the right agent.
2. Tap "Use free" — there is nothing to pay and nothing to buy.
3. Describe the job in plain words. Guided setup happens right on the page.
4. The agent reads live public sources and reports back what it found, naming the source of every figure.

## Money, honestly

- The agents give honest information and guidance from public sources. **No
  income figure, medical diagnosis, or other outcome is promised or
  guaranteed.**
- Agent01 never pays users and offers no payouts.

## Community agents — free help

- **Agent 46 — Healthcare**: finds nearby doctors, clinics, hospitals, and
  pharmacies (OpenStreetMap), explains medicines from FDA data (OpenFDA),
  finds clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov), and links to NIH/MedlinePlus
  explainers. It cannot book appointments, access medical records, or
  diagnose. General information only — never medical advice.
- **Agent 56 — Public Health**: live air quality and weather for any place
  on Earth from free public data (Open-Meteo, OpenAQ, and national weather
  services such as the US National Weather Service), plus low-cost care
  near you. For any named area it monitors outbreak signals
  (GDELT, labeled as media reports — never confirmed cases), official WHO/CDC
  statements, the latest available satellite imagery (Sentinel-2/Copernicus,
  never live), air (OpenAQ/Open-Meteo), water (USGS), pollen, health alerts,
  and nearby hospitals, pharmacies, and vaccination sites (OpenStreetMap).
  General information only — never medical advice or a diagnosis.
- **Agent 57 — Social Services**: step-by-step help applying for benefits (SNAP,
  Medicaid, TANF, SSI/SSDI, housing) in plain language, pointing to the
  local help lines for your country (2-1-1 in the US) and official sources. General information only — not legal advice;
  eligibility varies by state and real caseworkers decide.

## The mission

Agent01 is aligned with the mission of safe superintelligence: powerful AI,
built safely, to benefit humanity. That mission, published by Safe
Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), is the project's north star. Agent01 is an
independent project — not affiliated with, partnered with, or endorsed by SSI
or any AI lab. In the project's own words: "The objective is to benefit
humanity using the technology enabled with God's Eye."

## The three agents

- **Agent 46 — Healthcare** (free): Find care, medicines & studies — nearby
  doctors, clinics, hospitals, pharmacies; FDA drug information; clinical
  trials; NIH/MedlinePlus explainers. Information only, never diagnosis.
- **Agent 56 — Public Health** (free): Local health alerts and air quality
  from free public data — plus outbreak, air, water, and care monitoring for
  any area you name.
- **Agent 57 — Social Services** (free): Step-by-step help applying for
  benefits — plain language, official sources.
